<p style="margin-left: 40px; ">''You might also be looking for [[Sheriff Bartlett's Journal]], a game feature of Red Dead Revolver.''</p>

The '''Journal''' in ''[[Red Dead Redemption]]'' is accessed through the start menu. It includes the brief, this shows everything the game has asked you to do or what NPC's have said. The player can look at this if they have forgotten what they have to do in their mission or side quest. The journal also displays the [[Strangers]] quests that are active.

An important thing that it displays is the [[Challenges]] such as [[Sharpshooter]] and [[Master Hunter Challenges|Master Hunter]]. These show you how far you are in completing the challenge and what you have to do to complete it. You can also access the Journal menu in multiplayer.
